reports.title: Alvotech Announces Financial Results for the Nine Months to September 30, 2026, with a Business Update

guidance.heading: Outlook for the Full Year 2026
section: Alvotech maintains its full-year 2026 guidance for total revenue of $650-$700 million and EBITDA of $180-$220 million, with performance now expected toward the lower end of the range. The Company remains focused on executing planned product deliveries in the fourth quarter, as production and commercial supply continue to ramp up following the manufacturing improvement program completed in the first half of the year.
